snippet.title: Cardinal Descent Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Cardinal Descent is a card building roguelike where you craft elemental synergies and find game breaking sticker combos.

Play the demo and wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3114100/Cardinal_Descent/
